reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original B1/B2 noun exercises: checked each full German sentence, all four options, case/gender/inflection (especially Betriebsratsvorsitzende and Betroffener), answer uniqueness, useful bilingual feedback and two distinct situations per seed. Existing objectives inspected; no identical objective found. Corrected source gloss for Betriebsratsvorsitzende and declined inherited long third-party Beweis example. No human linguistic, CEFR, provenance or publication approval.
